latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Photo Generator.

- Generate AI-powered images and 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, SVG files up to 200MB; outputs include multiple image and video formats.
- Automatic authentication with 100 free credits for new users.
- Cloud GPU rendering: fast processing (20–40 seconds per image).
- Session management preserves timeline and project edits.
- Simple upload, generate, preview, and export workflows for marketers, designers, and content creators.
